title: Bounded module cache pruning
objective: Add a safe explicit sagejs cache prune command with conservative bounded retention, active-version leases, dry-run reporting, cross-platform path safety, focused tests, and documentation

handoff.summary: Adds an explicit dry-run-first `sagejs cache prune` command for whole compiler-version module caches, with current/recent/pinned/leased retention, a conservative age/size policy, atomic quarantine before deletion, fail-closed path checks, runtime heartbeat leases, documentation, and temporary-directory-only tests.
risks: Only Linux x64 was executed in this lane; path and rename behavior is implemented with cross-platform Node APIs and the tests include a Windows junction-compatible symlink case.
The size ceiling is intentionally best effort because current, active, pinned, newest, and grace-period versions always win over space reclamation.
next_steps: Run the broader integration/portable suites after coordinator integration.
Do not invoke `--apply` against a user's real cache without first reviewing the default dry-run report.
